name: Raid Review
teaser: A web-based post raid replay system of your SPT raids; detailed replay system with heatmap overlay, review kills, lootings, positional data, and just get a general understanding of what was going on in your raids!
description:
Play YouTube video

This mod has been updated by Chazut recently, thank you so much for your work to get it compatible with 4.0. Sorry I have not had a chance to work on this for quite sometime, but Chazut is a legend for making this happen. Enjoy the mod 😊 - Ekky

Every raid you play gets recorded: positions, kills, loot, bot decisions. After extract, replay the whole thing on an interactive map, scrub the timeline, and find out what actually happened - who hunted you across the map, what that scav was thinking, where the good loot you missed was sitting.

Quick start: install, play a few raids with the SPT server running, then hit F5 in game or browse to http://127.0.0.1:7829.

What You’ll See
  • The PMC that one-tapped you at minute 12? Follow him from spawn: which rooms he looted, who he killed before you, and the line straight to your head with weapon, distance and body part.
  • Scrub back to minute 3 and watch the scav horde slowly drift toward Resort while you were looting the gas station, blissfully unaware.
  • Hover any bot: his health, his current decision (“searching”, “fleeing”, “looting”), his personality, his squad’s plan.
  • Open the loot layer and cry at the gold-tier marker two rooms from where you turned around.
  • Check the leaderboard: factions, K/D, accuracy bars, loot value, and who killed who at a glance.
Map Replay

Replay the entire raid on an interactive map with full positional tracking.

  • Animated replay with a timeline scrubber, up to 16x speed
  • Follow mode: click any player in the legend to lock the camera on them
  • Map layers for multi-story maps
  • Tooltips with player info, faction, level, live health and behavior
  • Timeline events: click to jump to that moment
  • BTR shown with a dedicated APC silhouette icon
  • Ghost bots (ORBIT AI limiter): sleeping bots show faded, and their simulated fights draw an exchange line on the map while they happen

Kills

See exactly who killed who, where, and when.

  • Kill lines: hover a player to draw lines from killer to each victim
  • Death markers with killfeed tooltips (weapon, distance, body part)
  • Legend highlights: victims glow green, the killer glows red
  • Timeline-aware: only shows what already happened at the current position

Leaderboard

The post-raid breakdown of everyone in the raid.

  • Faction badges
  • KIA / Alive status, sortable Level / Kills / Looted / Accuracy columns
  • Kill relationships: click a row to highlight their victims and killer
  • Loot value looted in-raid + gear value at spawn

Charts & Stats
  • Active bots / kills / looting / projectiles over time, each point with a killfeed-style tooltip (who, what, with which weapon)
  • Bots by faction and difficulty pie charts
  • PMC personalities pie chart (requires SAIN)
  • Color-coded timeline: red kills, orange drops, green looting

Bot Minds

See what every bot was thinking. Works best with SAIN, vanilla AI supported too.

  • Behavior rings around bot markers: combat red, search orange, loot yellow, flee purple, extract green, and more
  • Gantt timeline on the /behavior page: one horizontal bar per bot, zoomable, with spawn/death indicators
  • SAIN deep integration (combat / self / squad decisions, active layer) with a vanilla fallback
  • With ORBIT: tooltips tell you WHY a bot is going somewhere or extracting, click a bot to see its squad’s whole plan, and a map overlay shows the hotspot field pulling them around

Loot

Every piece of loot that existed in the raid, on the map.

  • Price-coded markers: gray (<10K) to gold (>500K), ground items and container contents alike
  • Dropped items appear as dashed markers, disappear when picked up
  • Sidebar panel: sortable, searchable, price filter, hover to locate on the map, click to pan
  • Bot inventories: inspect any bot’s spawn gear, slot by slot, with attachments and total value

Installation
  1. Extract the zip into your SPT root folder
  2. Play a few raids with the SPT server running.
  3. Hit F5 in game, or browse to http://127.0.0.1:7829.

Fika is supported (regular hosted and headless), install on ONE machine only:

  • Regular Fika: install on the host’s machine. The host records everything (all bots, all connected players); clients need nothing.
  • Fika headless: install on the headless client only. Small caveat: the headless has no “main player”, so the raid type always shows PMC and connected players appear as PMCs in the leaderboard. Everything else works normally.
Supported Mods

Raid Review unlocks extra visualizations when these mods are installed. None are required - install only what you use.

SAIN (highly recommended)

  • Bot decisions on the map and behavior timeline, personality breakdown chart

ORBIT

  • Squad goals on the map (loot a rich area, hunt PvP, run a quest), and tooltips telling you WHY a bot goes somewhere or extracts
  • Click a bot to see its whole squad’s plan
  • Hotspot field overlay showing where bots are being pulled
  • ORBIT 2.0: sleeping ghost bots faded on the replay, simulated ghost fights drawn on the map with duration and casualties

Phobos

  • Bot objective tooltips and the advection field overlay

QuestingBots

  • Bot tooltips show which quest they’re running

LootingBots

  • Bots show as “looting” on the map and timeline

All faction and boss mods

  • Their bots get their own faction badges in the leaderboard
Issues

Report them on GitHub, it’s much easier for me to track and fix!

Credits
  • ekky for creating Raid Review.
  • The entire SPT team for an amazing framework, and documentation.
  • SPT Discord, specifically people active in the ‘mod-development’ and ‘dev-community’ channels.
  • The folks over at tarkov.dev for the MIT-licensed interactive map this is built on.
  • You for downloading the mod, and taking the time to install it.
